name: Afrikaans
about: Grade 10 Afrikaans First Additional Language: the passive voice, direct and indirect speech, the environment and careers.

af: Die brief word deur Sipho geskryf.
en: The letter is being written by Sipho.
The letter is written by Sipho.

af: Die huis word geverf.
Die kos word in die kombuis voorberei.
en: The food is being prepared in the kitchen.
The food is prepared in the kitchen.

af: Die nuus word elke aand uitgesaai.
en: The news is broadcast every evening.
The news is broadcast every night.

drills.en: Rewrite in the passive (word ... deur ... ge-).
to: Die brief word deur Sipho geskryf.
Die koek word deur die kinders geëet.
Die kos word deur Ma gekook.

af: Die brug is in 1990 gebou.
Die venster is deur die bal gebreek.
en: The window was broken by the ball.

af: Die prys is aan die beste leerder gegee.
en: The prize was given to the best learner.

af: Die wedstryd is weens die reën uitgestel.
en: The match was postponed because of the rain.
The match was postponed due to the rain.

drills.task: Skryf in die lydende vorm (verlede tyd).
drills.en: Passive, past tense: "het ... ge-" becomes "is ... ge-".
drills.from: Die seun het die venster gebreek.
to: Die venster is deur die seun gebreek.

drills.task: Skryf in die lydende vorm (verlede tyd).
drills.from: My oupa het die huis gebou.
to: Die huis is deur my oupa gebou.

drills.task: Skryf in die lydende vorm (verlede tyd).
drills.from: Die polisie het die dief gevang.
to: Die dief is deur die polisie gevang.

af: Ons moet die omgewing beskerm.
en: We have to protect the environment.

af: Plastiek kan herwin word.
Besoedeling is 'n groot probleem in ons stede.
en: Pollution is a big problem in our cities.
Pollution is a major problem in our cities.

af: Gooi jou afval in die asblik.
en: Throw your litter in the bin.
Put your litter in the bin.

drills.from: Die boek word deur die leerder gelees.

drills.en: Rewrite in the active voice (past tense).
drills.from: Die liedjie is deur die koor gesing.
to: Die koor het die liedjie gesing.
Die papier word deur die leerders herwin.

af: Sy sê dat sy moeg is.
en: She says that she is tired.

af: Hy vra of ons honger is.
en: He asks whether we are hungry.
He asks if we are hungry.

af: Die onderwyser verduidelik dat die toets moeilik sal wees.
en: The teacher explains that the test will be difficult.
The teacher explains that the test will be hard.

af: Ek antwoord dat ek nie weet nie.
en: I answer that I do not know.

drills.en: Rewrite as indirect speech (dat ..., verb at the end; ek becomes sy/hy).
to: Thandi sê dat sy honger is.
Pieter sê dat hy rugby speel.

drills.from: Ma vra vir Thabo: "Is jy klaar?"
to: Ma vra vir Thabo of hy klaar is.

af: Sy het gesê dat sy siek was.
en: She said that she was sick.

af: Hy het gevra of ek hom kon help.
en: He asked whether I could help him.
He asked if I could help him.

af: Die hoof het aangekondig dat die skool vroeg sou sluit.
en: The principal announced that the school would close early.
The principal announced that school would close early.

drills.en: After "het gesê", the present tense moves into the past (is becomes was).
to: Sipho het gesê dat hy moeg was.

drills.en: Rewrite as indirect speech (kan becomes kon).
drills.from: Lerato het gesê: "Ek kan nie kom nie."
to: Lerato het gesê dat sy nie kon kom nie.

drills.en: Rewrite as indirect speech (sal becomes sou).
drills.from: Die hoof het gesê: "Die skool sal vroeg sluit."
to: Die hoof het gesê dat die skool vroeg sou sluit.

af: Watter beroep wil jy volg?
en: Which career do you want to follow?
What career do you want to follow?
Which career do you want to pursue?
What career do you want to pursue?

af: Ek het môre 'n onderhoud vir 'n werk.
en: I have an interview for a job tomorrow.
I have a job interview tomorrow.
Tomorrow I have a job interview.

af: Hy het baie ervaring as elektrisiën.
en: He has a lot of experience as an electrician.
He has much experience as an electrician.

af: Verpleegsters kry drie jaar opleiding.
en: Nurses get three years of training.
Nurses receive three years of training.

drills.en: Write in the future tense with "sal".

to: Die salaris word deur die maatskappy betaal.

drills.from: Sy wil 'n dokter word. Sy wil mense help.
to: Sy wil 'n dokter word omdat sy mense wil help.
